summary.text: Dixon McMakin is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 68, representing East Baton Rouge, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2023 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Dixon McMakin's occupation as Financial Advisor, Insurance Broker and Lawyer.
It lists Dixon McMakin's education as B.G.S., Louisiana State University, 2009; M.B.A., Louisiana State University, 2013; J.D., Paul M. Hebert Law Center, Louisiana State University, 2013.
The House member page lists Dixon McMakin's committee assignments as Commerce; House and Governmental Affairs; Retirement; House Executive Committee.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Capital Region Legislative Delegation (Chair); Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
